indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: Region all-persons population represented in the wave's religion table.
indicators.method: Printed region total: 2009 Brief Results Section 7.1; 2021 Brief Results Section 7.1.
indicators.quality_notes: Every wave counts all persons of all ages; there is no universe break. The region frame changes between waves (16 vs 17 units, the 2018 South Kazakhstan split), so no cross-wave region change is claimed.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the region population reporting affiliation with a named religion (Islam, Christianity, Judaism, Buddhism, or Other).
indicators.quality_notes: The seven top-level categories are identical across waves (Islam, Christianity, Judaism, Buddhism, Other, Non-believers, Refused). Affiliation is read as levels per wave, not as cross-wave change (2018 frame break). Percentages use each region's printed census population total. The Refused-to- indicate line stays in the denominator and outside both headline numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%.

indicators.label: No religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share in the census Non-believers line (неверующие / дінге сенбейтіндер).
indicators.method: 100 * (Non-believers line) / population. Refused to indicate is not part of this slot.
indicators.quality_notes: The Refused-to-indicate share rose sharply between waves (national 0.5% in 2009 to 11.0% in 2021); it is a disclosed residual, never folded into the no-religion slot. Percentages use each region's printed census population total. The Refused-to- indicate line stays in the denominator and outside both headline numerators, so the two shares need not sum to 100%.
